newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: One soldier, four rebels die in Colombia clashes.
newsitem.headline: One soldier, four rebels die in Colombia clashes.

text.p: Clashes between leftist guerrillas and the army on Monday left at least four rebels and one soldier dead, Colombian military authorities said.
Four fighters of the Cuban-inspired National Liberation Army (ELN) died near the town of Vegachi in northwest Antioquia province, an army spokesman said.
The men were thought to be part of the same rebel commando that had carried out a wave of kidnappings in the area in recent weeks.
The second firefight took place in mountains near the town of Acacias in eastern Meta province as Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels went to blow up a nearby highway tollbooth.
Regional army commander Gen. Jaime Humberto Uscategui said one soldier was killed and others suffered minor shrapnel wounds.

In a separate incident in the central Magdalena Medio region, suspected ELN rebels kidnapped a Spanish electrician, Manuel Ibanez, and two Colombian engineers carrying out railroad repair work, the NTC TV news programme reported.
The incidents come the day after the FARC, Colombia's oldest and largest guerrilla army, ambushed a military patrol in southern Caqueta province, killing five soldiers and injuring 17 others.
